submission.justification:
Algorithm-L1 with a 30 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 92.806% among all three candidate algorithms across the allowed threshold range (20-60 GeV). This represents:
- A 7.7% efficiency gain over Algorithm-L2 (best: 85.075% at 30 GeV)
- A 19.6% efficiency gain over Algorithm-L3 (best: 73.186% at 40 GeV)
- A 0.9% improvement over the baseline efficiency target of 92%

The 30 GeV threshold optimizes the signal efficiency for Algorithm-L1, balancing acceptance of signal events while maintaining the allocated trigger rate of 8 kHz. All three algorithms are deployable in Level-1 trigger hardware, and the threshold falls within the required 20-60 GeV range. Algorithm-L1 clearly provides the best performance for achieving the goal of maximizing signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
